description: A click on a link the moment a SPA navigation shows the new page, while its View Transition still runs, reaches the link, and a click on a button inside a component's shadow root reaches that button

browserSteps.value: SPA navigation to the second page starts a View Transition
Click the second page's link with a real mouse press as soon as it is shown, before the transition ends
The same quick click on the shared top menu
Click a button inside a component's shadow root with a real mouse press as soon as it is shown, before the transition ends

new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const deadline = performance.now() + 5000; const poll = () => { if (window.__shadowNextClicks === 1) { resolve(true); return; } if (performance.now() > deadline) { reject(new Error('the click did not reach the button inside the shadow root; clicks: ' + window.__shadowNextClicks)); return; } setTimeout(poll, 50); }; poll(); })
